chapter: Jazz opinions, Jelly Roll and the Rhythm Club
title: Sidney Bechet and Creole musicians
summary: He loved Bechet and knows nothing of Creole versus other black musicians.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: What did you think of Sidney Bechet?
I loved him. You did too.
at course. Did you ever encounter things that they write about in the history about Creole musicians opposed to the other black musicians?

No, never. I don't know nothing about no Creole black musicians or nothing. I just know about people. 'Creole Lady' - name of the tune, that's about all I know. Chicago music and New Orleans music and all those kinds -
